newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGB futures end up after trading in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: JGB futures end up after trading in narrow range.

text.p: Key June Japanese government bond (JGB) futures ended Tuesday's Tokyo session slightly higher after trading in a narrow range.
June closed up 0.08 at 126.56, after trading between 126.41 and 126.70. Turnover was 37,280.
Traders said the benchmark contract was capped by heavy offers near 126.70 worth about 800 lots.

"Dealers were unwilling to test higher levels due to the recent massive offering of new corporate bonds. However, they were also reluctant to test lower as investors are likely to buy on dips," said a brokerage house trader.
